method: Fresh independent read-only audit of all 216 frozen web files (135 application/configuration/documentation/style files and 81 test/support files; 56,184 lines). Used the current source only, not diffs, old audits, sibling repositories or Git history. Traversed every current TypeScript/TSX/MJS AST with the installed TypeScript compiler API, checked syntactic diagnostics, and manually reviewed the resulting per-file call/guard/effect/test structures. This structural review is not a claim that every source line was manually read. Manually read and traced complete sensitive user flows in App/Workspace, models/providers/defaults/config aliases, automations, projects/drafts, login/MFA/device login, recovery/receipts, terminal/events, composer/context/attachments, approvals/dialogs/Markdown, with targeted raw-source review of other modules and complete CSS/configuration/support review. Assessed test intent and missing integration coverage without running the existing test suite. Executed exactly one new narrow jsdom probe against the real App, Workspace and Sidebar components using isolated test homes and mocked local fetch/WebSocket; the passing assertion establishes the reported draft-loss defect. No full suite, broad typecheck/build, live browser visual/IME check, real PTY/OAuth/cloud CLI/model/external MCP or online deployment integration was executed. Independently recomputed the whole-repository frozen digest and every inspected file hash at completion.

topicResults.topic: Multi-provider account settings and legacy single-provider compatibility
topicResults.result: Traced provider/account ownership, default selection, mutation/recovery gates and provider aliases. Runtime/deploy reviewers independently verified that legacy public provider state synthesizes a default connection; therefore the UI connections branch is not treated as a missing legacy entry point.

topicResults.topic: Model/effort popup and actual paginated provider catalogs
topicResults.result: Traced model identity, provider alias matching, cursor paging, explicit refresh/invalidation and error states across picker, catalog, config, automations and thread execution settings; no additional confirmed defect.
Read form serialization, validation, model/effort resolution, trigger/time controls, run ownership, unknown receipts and handoff paths; no additional confirmed defect.

Confirmed ordinary project navigation bypasses the draft departure check; project-creation automatic handoff already checks canLeave, but Sidebar/thread/new/back/other navigation entry points do not consistently share it. Actual App/Sidebar click probe confirms loss after storage failure.
Read login/setup/MFA and settings entry wiring, device-login memory-only handoff lifecycle, cancellation/recovery controls and usage popup ownership/retry rendering; no additional confirmed defect.

topicResults.topic: Attention-only receipts and restart/cloud CLI recovery
topicResults.result: Traced attention filtering and explicit receipt reconciliation, no automatic mutation replay, terminal lease/reconnect ownership and diagnostics/service recovery actions. Real cloud login/CLI/PTY integration was not exercised.

Reviewed every remaining source/test structure, including workspace files/git/search/watch/downloads, history/search/thread organization, runtime execution/realtime/media, MCP/extensions/plugins/skills/imports, settings, security/admin, rendering budgets, prompts and keyboard/dialog behavior. All CSS files were manually read; no real browser visual regression run.

findings.title: 普通导航绕过草稿离开检查，导致保存失败的输入永久丢失
findings.description: Sidebar 的真实项目点击在 Workspace 中直接 setProjectId(id) 再 navigate('')，navigate 本身也不调用 draftState.canLeave。useDraft 只有当前 key 的内存副本；切换 key 后 load 会用新 key 的持久化记录覆盖 current 并清空 unsaved/error。因此 sessionStorage 写入失败（配额不足或存储被阻止）时，用户仍可切换项目/会话，返回后未保存输入消失，原保存失败提示也消失。只针对项目创建成功的自动跳转加 canLeave 无法保护普通导航。
userSteps: 已登录且有项目 A、B；位于项目 A 的新会话编辑器。
让 sessionStorage 对 harness.draft.v1.* 的 setItem 抛出 QuotaExceededError，输入一段消息，看到草稿保存失败提示。
点击实际侧栏的项目 B，再点击项目 A。
实际消息 textarea 已为空，原来的保存失败提示也消失；未保存文本只有内存副本且已丢失。
findings.impact: 存储异常时常规站内导航会静默丢失用户尚未发送的输入；已有持久化草稿可能回退为旧版本。项目切换路径已执行验证；同一无保护导航函数涉及的其他入口是源码追踪结论，未声称逐个进行交互实测。

relatedLocations.reason: 实际项目按钮调用 onProject(p.id)。
统一 navigate 未做草稿离开检查。
popstate 直接重置当前路由状态。
只保留同 key 的未保存输入；新 key 读入后覆盖当前内存副本。
已有普通 canLeave 与已发送快照 canLeaveAfterAcceptance，可复用其不同语义。

findings.validation: A single isolated jsdom test passed, asserting the unwanted data loss through the real App + Sidebar click path. Only HTTP/WebSocket and unused xterm integrations were mocked; no Workspace/Sidebar callback substitutes were used.
findings.recommendation: 在 Workspace 的集中导航所有者处同步检查是否可离开；检查通过前不要先修改 projectId、threadId、分支、modal 或 history。存储失败时保留当前页面，提供重试保存及明确放弃未保存修改动作，并保留已受理发送的精确快照清理例外。将项目、会话、新会话、popstate、自动项目选择、打开工作区/原生终端、打开草稿、恢复/分支/审阅后的跳转统一纳入检查。

repairBoundary: Centralize the synchronous departure decision before any route/project/draft identity mutation; avoid a Sidebar-only patch and avoid adding an unbounded cross-key cache.
Cover manual project/thread/new-chat entry points; popstate needs explicit URL consistency when departure is blocked.
Cover automatic missing-project fallback, thread cwd-to-project mapping, openWorkspace and native terminal handoffs.
Cover DraftsSettings new/thread/branch draft opening and recovery/history/fork/review/import/deletion result handoffs.
Preserve existing asynchronous navigation owner checks and canLeaveAfterAcceptance semantics for exact accepted send snapshots; do not clear later edits or ABA revisions.
Provide retry-save and explicit discard actions without requiring destructive storage clearing; do not mutate source until the remaining frozen audit reports finish.
unexecutedIntegrations: Full test suite and broad build/typecheck
Real PTY and cloud CLI/authentication recovery
Real OAuth/MFA device or external login service
Commercial model inference and external MCP

narrowProbe.purpose: Confirmed defect reproduction, not a clean-test conclusion
